set(PICO_BOARD_HEADER_DIRS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR})
set(PICO_BOARD nn22board)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)

project(DetBoardFirmware_project C CXX ASM)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

pico_sdk_init()

add_executable(DetBoardFirmware
  DetBoardFirmware.c
)

pico_generate_pio_header(DetBoardFirmware ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/adcacq_main.pio)
pico_generate_pio_header(DetBoardFirmware ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/adcacq_miso_b.pio)


pico_enable_stdio_usb(DetBoardFirmware 0)
pico_enable_stdio_uart(DetBoardFirmware 0)

# prevent slow execution on first cycle
pico_set_binary_type(DetBoardFirmware copy_to_ram)

target_link_libraries(DetBoardFirmware 
                      pico_stdlib
                      pico_unique_id
                      hardware_adc
                      hardware_pio
                      hardware_pll
                      hardware_clocks
                      )

pico_add_extra_outputs(DetBoardFirmware)
